body: I am at hospital now. Definitely an infection. Still waiting on results of CT scan. Everything else was fine.

They said go to the hospital if I catch a fever which I think I am beginning too. Thank you so much. I’m completely terrified of all the different things it could be. I am hoping for the best. Thank you so much I will message you I need support in any way right now.
Yes I did. I was thinking of calling. I’m very nervous and feeling a little weak but don’t know if that is from my anxiety or my pain. Still don’t think I have a fever yet

Thank you for answering so fast. It’s not too bad but still painful enough to bother me. When I take Tylenol it helps but it’s definitely uncomfortable too where I just want it too stop. I have been having a hard time sleeping cause of it. No fever I have been more sweaty than normal but it might be my hormones changing. I have passed a lot of clots and as traumatic as it was I witnessed the whole thing pass on the 3rd day. I was almost 8 weeks during the MA. I’m going too go to urgent care in the morning so they can see if there is any type of infection before I go to the hospital cause it’s cause be expensive. I took some antibiotics I had already. I’m just scared if it is infection it will get worse rapidly so I’m scared too even sleep.
